# Philips N4520 Player v0.0.22

## Changes

- Fixes reel sticker scaling in narrow Home Assistant cards.
- Converts the sticker's fixed pixel placement offset to reel-relative percentage positioning.
- Scales sticker text from the reel container size instead of the browser viewport.

## Notes

The sticker should now keep the same size relationship to the left reel as the
card is resized, including compact dashboard layouts.
